headline: Sensex jumps 1,502 points as IT stocks and foreign inflows drive a major market rally

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Significant foreign fund inflows provided a major boost to market sentiment.
Strong buying interest in IT shares despite global concerns over US tariff threats.
Real estate stocks including Prestige and Lodha witnessed a strong rally.
Sugar and power equipment sectors saw positive momentum and renewed investor interest.
whatHappening: The Nifty 50 index surged by 1.85%, crossing the 25,800 mark during the session.
Sensex recovered from an early drop of 150 points to gain over 1,500 points.
IT index jumped 2% as investors focused on sectoral growth despite tariff news.
FMCG stocks experienced profit booking while sugar stocks regained their sweetness.
summary: Indian stock markets surged as the Sensex gained 1,502 points, supported by a robust rally in IT and real estate sectors. Foreign institutional investors turned net buyers, offsetting initial volatility caused by US tariff news. While most sectors performed well, FMCG stocks saw profit booking as capital rotated into sugar and power equipment.
